changes_made.explanation: Removed Yelp and CNN/DM datasets as they are only mentioned in passing as examples or comparisons, not actually used in experiments. Added models that are explicitly evaluated (Copycat, Coop, MeanSum) and foundational models used (VAE, DSS-VAE). Expanded outputs description to be more comprehensive.
Normalized all ROUGE variants to base ROUGE metric per guidelines
No LLMs were used as judges - the paper only uses human evaluation and automatic metrics

guideline: Best-Worst Scaling evaluation where experts highlight best and worst summary per triad according to predefined criteria

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria names by removing acronyms and clarified guideline description

overall_notes: The paper focuses on unsupervised abstractive opinion summarization across multiple datasets. The extraction quality was generally good, but needed some refinement - removing datasets that were only mentioned in passing (Yelp, CNN/DM) and normalizing metrics. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics (ROUGE) and comprehensive human evaluation but no LLM-based evaluation.
